signals.headline: Nearly 20 people still missing after ferry capsizes ⁠off northern Cyprus
signals.summary: Nearly 20 people are still missing after a ferry capsized ⁠off northern Cyprus, killing at least eight, as divers join search teams scouring deep waters for ⁠any survivors.
keyTakeaways: The double-hulled ⁠ferry ​with 267 people onboard took in water and flipped over on Sunday just off the port city ⁠of Kyrenia, leaving survivors clinging to the upturned hull.
Of three friends travelling home to see their families, one had been found but the other two were still missing, he added.
It was unclear ‌if people remained trapped on the vessel, now lying on the seabed at a depth of more ​than 500 metres (1,640ft).
signals.whyItMatters: Separate accounts said the wide-bodied ​vessel jolted violently before ‌slamming on to ​the sea ​surface, with part of its bow bursting open on impact.

ja.headline: 北キプロス沖でフェリー転覆、依然20人近くが行方不明
ja.summary: 北キプロス沖でフェリーが転覆し、これまでに少なくとも8人が死亡した。依然として20人近くの行方が分かっておらず、潜水チームも加わって深い海域での捜索が続いている。
keyTakeaways: 267人を乗せた二重船体のフェリーは日曜日、港町ケリニアの沖合で浸水し転覆、生存者は裏返った船体にしがみついて救助を待った。
帰省中だった友人3人組のうち、1人は発見されたが残る2人は依然行方不明だという。
船体は水深500メートル余りの海底に沈んでおり、なお人が閉じ込められているかどうかは分かっていない。
ja.whyItMatters: 複数の証言によれば、船体は激しく揺さぶられたのち海面に叩きつけられ、衝撃で船首の一部が破損したという。

signals.headline: 'A giant leap forward': Nasa launches powerful new space telescope
signals.summary: Nasa's powerful next-generation telescope has blasted off into space from its launchpad in Florida, with a mission to explore dark energy, black holes and other mysteries of the Universe.
keyTakeaways: The Nancy Grace Roman telescope will capture vast panoramic views of space, with a field of vision 100 times larger than both the Hubble and James Webb space telescopes, Nasa says.
The mission begins with a 100-day journey to a vantage point roughly one million miles from Earth, where the telescope will then start charting planets outside our solar system, known as exoplanets.
The successful launch of the telescope took place on Sunday morning local time from the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
signals.whyItMatters: The new telescope is similarly expected to revolutionise our understanding of the Universe, including through investigating dark energy.

ja.headline: 新型宇宙望遠鏡、打ち上げ成功 宇宙の謎に挑む
ja.summary: NASAの次世代宇宙望遠鏡が、フロリダの発射台から宇宙へと飛び立った。目指すのはダークエネルギーやブラックホールなど、宇宙に残された数々の謎の解明だ。
keyTakeaways: ナンシー・グレース・ローマン望遠鏡は、ハッブルやジェイムズ・ウェッブの百倍にあたる視野を持つとNASAは説明する。
地球から約百六十万キロ離れた観測地点まで百日かけて移動し、その後は太陽系外惑星の観測を開始する。
打ち上げは現地時間の日曜朝、フロリダのケネディ宇宙センターから行われ、成功を収めた。
ja.whyItMatters: ダークエネルギーの解明などを通じ、この望遠鏡は宇宙への理解を大きく塗り替えると期待されている。

signals.headline: One dead and more than a dozen missing after 'terrifying' flash flood hits Grand Canyon
signals.summary: The flood hit Bright Angel Canyon and the Phantom Ranch area on Saturday afternoon, wiping out footbridges and propelling boulders downstream.
keyTakeaways: Baggs said she and her friends had just dropped off their belongings at a cabin in Phantom Ranch - a remote lodge at the bottom of the Grand Canyon - when they decided to venture out to enjoy the nice day.
Before they knew it, a flood of water was sweeping through the area.
The recent rains in the Grand Canyon area, and more widely in south-western parts of the US, are due to monsoonal showers.
signals.whyItMatters: The threat of flooding is something that will remain for many more weeks.

signals.headline: ‘Scary’: how misinformation and AI hallucinations are infiltrating Australia’s parliament
signals.summary: A ustralia’s government inquiry process is supposed to help parliament make better decisions, hearing from experts and constituents alike.
keyTakeaways: In some cases, committee reports have cited submissions in which the majority of sources appear to be AI-generated “hallucinations”, when large language models (LLMs) invent content that looks real but doesn’t actually exist.
In some instances, Google’s AI summary and ChatGPT will also cite the inquiry submission with the fake reference as a source, creating an ongoing cycle of misinformation.

The author of the submission, Drilldown Reports, told Guardian Australia it used AI in its research process and had identified the errors in its follow-up submission – but the deadline had passed to have them corrected.
signals.whyItMatters: Haslam, who researches child and family adversity and maltreatment, says the reference was “scary” because it looked so real that someone taking a cursory look could be convinced.

ja.headline: 誤情報とAI幻覚、オーストラリア議会に入り込む
ja.summary: オーストラリアの議会調査制度は、専門家や市民の声を聞き、より良い政策判断を助けるための仕組みだ。だが近年、その根幹が揺らいでいる。
keyTakeaways: 委員会報告書が引用した提出資料の中には、出典の大半がAIの「幻覚」によって作られたものもあった。大規模言語モデルが、実在しない情報をもっともらしく生成していた
グーグルのAI要約やチャットGPTがその架空の出典を引用し、誤情報がさらに広がる循環が生まれている
提出者のドリルダウン・リポーツはガーディアン紙に対し、調査過程でAIを使用したと説明。誤りは追加提出で指摘したが、訂正の期限はすでに過ぎていたという
ja.whyItMatters: 子どもと家庭の逆境や虐待を研究するハスラム氏は、その架空の出典があまりに本物らしく、一見しただけでは信じてしまうほどだったことを「恐ろしい」と語る。
